headlines.title: Nationwide outage impacts Chase banking online and at some branches
headlines.description: A nationwide outage impacting Chase banking services Monday led some customers to report trouble accessing their accounts and withdrawing funds.

headlines.title: California sues ChatGPT maker OpenAI over rogue hacking incidents
headlines.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta filed a sweeping lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday, alleging the technology giant jeopardized public safety by creating AI models “without the safeguards and monitoring necessary to adequately protect” people.

headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” Jensen Huang being reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he resigned.

headlines.title: Flight delays and cancellations return to normal levels after weekend of travel chaos
headlines.description: Air travel across the United States was largely returning to normal Monday, although some disruption persisted as airlines scrambled to get back on schedule after a rare nationwide ground stop.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Trump 'would not mind' having Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: President Trump told reporters he "would not mind" if Jensen Huang were to be reinstated as Nvidia's CEO, saying he has "learned a big lesson" amid the scandal.

headlines.title: In-Person Shopping Sees Revival With Gen Z Leading the Trend
headlines.description: After years of decline, malls are experiencing a major comeback, with Gen Z shoppers hitting in-person stores at surprisingly high rates. NBC’s Allie Canal joins TODAY with a look at what’s driving the resurgence.

headlines.title: Are Black Friday Deals as Good as They Seem?
headlines.description: A new investigation found that some of the Black Friday and Cyber Monday discounts offered by major retailers may not be as good as they seem. NBC’s chief consumer investigative correspondent Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with everything consumers need to know as they prepare for the holiday shopping season.

headlines.title: Home Heating Costs Set to Surge: Here’s How to Save
headlines.description: As millions get set to face the coldest air of the season so far, they’ll be cranking up the heat — and they may want to brace for higher costs. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with ways to lower those winter bills, including installing smart thermostats, getting furnaces checked now, reversing ceiling fans, and more.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: 2 injured after taxiing planes collide at Miami International Airport
headlines.description: Two taxiing planes collided at Miami International Airport on Saturday night, officials said, a day after a nationwide ground stop disrupted flights across the country.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.
